description:
Nestled amidst the tranquil Cumbrian countryside, this spacious detached cottage offers a serene retreat. Featuring three double bedrooms and a generous living dining room, this property exudes charm and character. With two adjoining outbuildings, with potential for additional accommodation.

The property boasts a front garden and ample rear parking, along with a connected paddock spanning approximately five acres. An adjacent range of agricultural outbuildings adds to the property's versatility, while additional land is available by separate negotiation.

Enjoy breathtaking rural vistas from both the front and rear of the property, with convenient proximity to Hadrian's Wall, Kielder Nature Reserve, and the Northern Pennines. Embrace a peaceful lifestyle in this idyllic setting, where the beauty of the countryside beckons right to your doorstep.

Directions From Carlisle head north on the M6, leaving the M6 at junction 44. Follow the A7, taking the right signposted Kirklinton. Continue through Kirklinton, past Bolton Fell Moss nature reserve, then take the first left, down the single lane track to the property. The postcode will direct you to the property.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric and water being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested. Drainage is to a septic tank. Any alterations required to meet current regulations are to be the responsibility of the purchaser.

Please note no formal investigation has been carried out as to the operation of the sewerage system and septic tanks, it is understood they do not meet the current General Binding Rules 2020 and the property is being sold on this basis. All parties must ensure that their lenders are aware of this before submitting an offer.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • The neighbouring plot has planning permission to build a detached residential home. • The access road to the property is owned by a third party. The property has full vehicle and pedestrian access. Maintenance of the road is split between the property, a neighbouring property and the adjacent building plot.
